disclaimer: Entirely fictional person created for a hackathon. Not based on a real individual.
name: Eleni Markou
occupation: Project manager / structural engineer at Aegean Structures (fictional firm)

style.email_en: Short paragraphs, greeting 'Hi <name>,', sign-off 'Best,\nEleni' (or 'Thanks!\nEleni'), dash bullet lists for options, flags problems early, no exclamation marks except 'Thanks!'
style.chat_el: Short direct sentences, practical, says what she decided and why in one line, occasional 'οκ', '👍', hates being late, prefers text to phone calls

risk_attitudes.health: cautious: never 'monitors' red-flag symptoms; 7-day cut-off for persistent symptoms; second opinion before any elective procedure
risk_attitudes.safety_crisis: early mover: acts on incomplete information, prefers a false alarm over a late reaction
risk_attitudes.schedule: client deadlines are non-negotiable; renegotiates scope early rather than slipping late; protects Tue/Thu mornings for deep work; 20% estimate buffer

decision_rules.M1: Red-flag symptoms (radiating chest pain, breathless at rest, one-sided weakness, speech difficulty, sudden severe headache) -> emergency services immediately
decision_rules.M2: Temp >= 39.5, or >= 38.5 for >= 3 days, or SpO2 < 94 -> doctor within 24h
decision_rules.M3: Symptoms >= 7 days -> GP appointment this week + symptom log
decision_rules.M4: Elective procedure recommended -> independent second opinion first
decision_rules.C-EQ: critical: M>=5.5 & <=50km | high: (M>=5.0 & <=80km) or (M>=6.0 & <=150km) | medium: M>=4.0 & <=50km | else low
decision_rules.C-FI: critical: 112 alert or (<=3km & wind toward) | high: <=10km & wind toward | medium: <=10km or (<=25km & toward) | else low
decision_rules.C-BO: critical: >12h or (>4h & (>=38C or <=0C)) | high: >4h | medium: >1h | else low
decision_rules.C-HE: critical: >=43C | high: >=41C or (>=39C & >=3 days) | medium: >=36C | else low
decision_rules.T-LOAD: utilisation after new request: >100% high (renegotiate/decline) | >85% medium | else accept with buffer
decision_rules.T-SLIP: client-facing & >=3d & penalty -> critical | client-facing & >0 -> high | internal & >2d -> medium | else low
decision_rules.T-FOCUS: Tue/Thu 09:00-12:00 protected: decline unless client or urgent; then accept and move the block
